index_metadata.name: Holo UI Vault — Unified Dual-Dimension Index
index_metadata.description: Style taxonomy, functional classification with 7-dimension Feature Tokens, and harmonization rules. Component paths are in ROUTER.json; token specification in FEATURE_TOKENS.md.

rules: DO NOT read beautifului-components/index.html (32KB human visual preview, wastes tokens).
DO NOT recursively scan directories. Use ROUTER.json for component paths.
Single-task retrieval budget: maximum 1 snippet file + 1 shared CSS file.
Use ROUTER.json for fast path resolution, and FEATURE_TOKENS.md for multi-dimensional disambiguation.
Review STYLE_AND_SELECTION_GUIDE.md prior to combining different styles.

style_harmonization.principle: Beautiful UI provides interaction skeletons; Apple HIG provides visual tokens and physics. They can be seamlessly blended without conflict.
rules: When embedding Beautiful UI components into an Apple-themed project, map container radii to var(--apple-radius-lg) or var(--apple-radius-xl).
Replace dark solid surfaces with Apple Liquid Glass material: background: var(--apple-material-regular); backdrop-filter: var(--apple-blur-regular);
Ensure all clickable elements satisfy the Apple 44pt minimum touch boundary.
Adopt Apple Spring curve: transition-timing-function: var(--apple-ease-spring);
Maintain a single primary style hierarchy per viewport. Do not mix sharp brutalist elements with soft squircles.
Pair Rewamp UI tactile buttons (slide-to-confirm-button, shimmer-button) with Beautiful UI's dense data tables for high-impact action points.
Rewamp UI components use SF Pro and squircle radii, aligning natively with Apple HIG foundations.
When integrating Rewamp UI 3D AI Orbs, contain them in Apple Liquid Glass or Beautiful UI dark cards to maintain visual continuity.
Embed loading.dev micro-indicators (e.g., ld-arc, ld-linear-dots) directly inside Beautiful UI prompt bars and table cells for zero-runtime lightweight feedback without layout shift.
When embedding loading.dev indicators into Apple HIG layouts, set color: var(--apple-accent-blue) or var(--apple-text-secondary) and size to 16px-22px to match SF Pro symbol scales.
Never replace full 3D assistant fluid orbs (Rewamp UI) with micro-spinners; use micro-spinners strictly for atomic operation states.
Embed minimal theme toggles (themetoggle-components) into Beautiful UI or Apple HIG headers with zero CSS conflicts; currentColor automatically adapts to parent typography.
Pair ObsidianUI partner cards (split-showcase) with Apple HIG squircle containers and subtle spring physics for high-fidelity co-marketing showcases.
Pair Arc tactile controls (button, segmented-control, hold-to-confirm) with Beautiful UI or Apple HIG layouts for fluid spring micro-interactions.

feature_tokens_schema.cardinality: Exactly one value per dimension for every component. All 47 values are globally unique.

model-search-browser.name: Model Search Browser
model-search-browser.when: Rendering model search browser: A cmdk-based searchable model-repo browser: a controlled search input, a sort selector (downloads/likes/last-modified), result rows (repo id, author, compact download/like counts, relative last-modified, capped tag badges), load-more pagination, and a per-repo expandable file list (filename, quantization badge, human-readable size) with per-file select actions — plus loading, empty, and error-with-retry states. Purely presentational: every value arrives via props and every action leaves via a callback, so any backend can feed it (recommended wiring: the HuggingFace Hub API; a private registry or static fixtures work identically).
model-search-browser.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

model-selector.name: Model Selector
model-selector.when: Rendering model selector: A device-aware model picker: a list grouped by category, backend filter chips (WebGPU/ONNX/WASM/LiteRT) with live counts, per-model vision/tool-calling/cached badges, a download affordance for uncached models, and a delete-from-cache affordance for cached ones. Device-unfit models (e.g. a WebGPU-only model on a non-WebGPU device) are de-emphasized and labeled. Emits onSelect(modelId) and owns no selection state. Bind models to useModelRecommendations and hasWebGPU to useCapabilities.
model-selector.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

network-badge.name: Network Badge
network-badge.when: Rendering network badge: A reactive online/offline indicator (NetworkBadge) sourced from useNetworkStatus, plus an OfflineReady badge that signals the app's required model is cached on-device and can run with no network. Because local models keep working offline, offline is informational, not an error.
network-badge.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

provider-badge.name: Provider Badge
provider-badge.when: Rendering provider badge: Displays the RESOLVED provider identity - composing ProviderFallbackBadge for the tier and name - alongside the model id that actually served the request. While providerName is null it shows a Resolving provider placeholder, so the badge never claims a provider before one has resolved. Takes generic display props (providerName / tier / modelId / note). Distinct from ProviderFallbackBadge (the tier chip it composes): this adds the resolved provider identity plus the served model id. Data source: a provider-fallback resolver.
provider-badge.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

provider-fallback-badge.name: Provider Fallback Badge
provider-fallback-badge.when: Rendering provider fallback badge: Surfaces the active AI backend tier — a zero-download built-in (Chrome AI) vs a model-download provider (Transformers.js) — plus a WASM threading variant (Multi-thread when cross-origin isolated / SharedArrayBuffer is available, else Single-thread). A software-side sibling to DeviceBadge; data source useCapabilities (crossOriginIsolated) + provider identifier.
provider-fallback-badge.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

semantic-cache-status-bar.name: Semantic Cache Status Bar
semantic-cache-status-bar.when: Rendering semantic cache status bar: A compact toolbar row for useSemanticCache complementing CacheBadge: entry count, hit-rate percentage, an icon-only clear-cache button (when entries > 0), and an enable/disable toggle (with a spinner while the embedding model loads). Pairs with a per-message CachedAnnotation ("Cached (38ms)"). Distinct from CacheBadge (model-download cache) — this surfaces semantic-cache hits on responses. Data source useSemanticCache.
semantic-cache-status-bar.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

storage-meter.name: Storage Meter
storage-meter.when: Rendering storage meter: Shows origin/IndexedDB storage usage against quota as a meter, with a warning state past a configurable threshold and a graceful unavailable state (estimates are approximate and blocked in Safari private mode). Bind to useStorageQuota (default) or pass an explicit quota. Complements ContextUsageMeter (the token-budget gauge).
storage-meter.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

vector-export-panel.name: Vector Export Panel
vector-export-panel.when: Rendering vector export panel: An export surface for vector data — the counterpart to VectorImportFlow: a record/dimension count line, a row per export format (native JSON with vectors, CSV, JSONL — label, description, vectors-included / text-only indicator, per-format export action emitting onExport(formatId)), a busy state that disables all actions with a spinner on the active format, a zero-records disabled state, and an optional last-export banner (format, records, human-readable size, filename). Works with any backend; data source useImportExport (exportCSV, exportJSONL) plus a native JSON export.
vector-export-panel.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

vector-import-flow.name: Vector Import Flow
vector-import-flow.when: Rendering vector import flow: A guarded vector-import flow for useImportExport: a preview panel (detected-format badge, total / with-vectors / text-only counts, detected dimensions, dimension-mismatch warning, Cancel/Confirm), a phased progress bar (parsing → validating → embedding → importing), a result stats banner (imported/skipped/re-embedded counts, source format, duration), and a record-preview table for row-level sanity checks before a destructive ingest. References the cross-family FormatDetectionBadge and inlines a minimal fallback so it builds independently. Data source useImportExport.
vector-import-flow.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

vector-storage-observability.name: Vector Storage Observability
vector-storage-observability.when: Rendering vector storage observability: VectorDB observability complementing StorageMeter (quota): a compression-stats badge (SQ8 ratio + before/after size, e.g. "4.0x — 15KB→3.7KB"), a three-tier storage estimate (Raw Float32 / SQ8 4x / PQ 8–32x with the active tier highlighted), and a GPU-aware search-latency badge (accented when WebGPU-accelerated). Values derive from getCompressionStats() (a core function) + search timing, passed in as props; the nearest shipped hook is useStorageQuota.
vector-storage-observability.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

before-after-image-viewer.name: Before / After Image Viewer
before-after-image-viewer.when: Rendering before / after image viewer: Compare an original image with a transformed result — a two-panel grid with checkerboard transparency (shipped inline) or a segmented Original / Enhanced toggle. Pairs with useImageToImage / useSegmentImage.
before-after-image-viewer.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

bounding-box-overlay.name: Bounding Box Overlay
bounding-box-overlay.when: Rendering bounding box overlay: Color-coded detection boxes (with a companion DetectionLabelLegend) positioned over an image as percentage offsets from its natural dimensions, so placement is display-size independent. Serves object / face / hand / pose output.
bounding-box-overlay.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

image-processing-overlay.name: Image Processing Overlay
image-processing-overlay.when: Rendering image processing overlay: A full-bleed overlay over a dimmed source image while vision inference runs — spinner ring + icon + status + optional cancel, plus an animated scan variant (keyframes shipped inline). Renders nothing when idle. Driven by any vision hook's isLoading.
image-processing-overlay.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

image-result-gallery.name: Image Result Gallery
image-result-gallery.when: Rendering image result gallery: A responsive grid / list of image result cards sharing one data contract — in-flight overlay, hover metadata, confidence score, multi-select, delete, and staggered fade-in. Composes ConfidenceScoreBadge (Results family) via a registry dependency, with a minimal score-badge fallback inlined so it builds independently. Pairs with useClassifyImageZeroShot / useEmbedImage / useCaptionImage.
image-result-gallery.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

media-dropzone.name: Media Dropzone
media-dropzone.when: Rendering media dropzone: A drag-and-drop + click-to-browse image upload zone with idle / drag-over / processing states, accept-list + max-size validation via validateFile, an "add another" variant, and an onFiles(File[]) callback.
media-dropzone.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

video-canvas.name: Video Canvas
video-canvas.when: Rendering video canvas: A mirrored 16:9 webcam surface — a video element with a pixel-aligned transparent canvas overlay for landmark / skeleton drawing, an FPS badge, and a child slot. A shell for the MediaPipe streaming trackers (useDetectHands / useDetectPose / useDetectFace / useRecognizeGesture); the app supplies the stream and draw callback.
video-canvas.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

confidence-score-badge.name: Confidence Score Badge
confidence-score-badge.when: Rendering confidence score badge: Maps a 0–1 score to a semantic color tier (configurable thresholds; default high ≥ 0.8 success, medium ≥ 0.5 warning, low muted) and renders the formatted percentage as a flat pill badge or a radial dial (conic-gradient ring wired to CSS variables, not daisyUI). The shared scored-output atom replacing 12 copied score-color helpers; consumed cross-family by media-vision's ImageResultGallery. Pairs with useClassify / useClassifyZeroShot / useSemanticSearch / useAnswerQuestion. Self-contained and presentational; exports resolveTier().
confidence-score-badge.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

cosine-similarity-meter.name: Cosine Similarity Meter
cosine-similarity-meter.when: Rendering cosine similarity meter: A display card showing a cosine similarity (0–1) as a large numeric value with a human-readable bucket label (Very similar … Unrelated) using configurable thresholds, plus a proportional half-ring SVG arc gauge. Derived from two embeddings (useEmbed / useEmbedImage). Self-contained; exports resolveBucket().
cosine-similarity-meter.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

editable-label-set.name: Editable Label Set
editable-label-set.when: Rendering editable label set: An editable set of color-cycling removable chips managing a candidate-label list (zero-shot candidate labels or any string-tag collection): hover-reveal remove, inline add input (Enter to commit, Backspace-on-empty to remove last). Fully controlled via labels / onAdd / onRemove, cycling a CSS-variable palette by index. Feeds useClassifyZeroShot candidate labels.
editable-label-set.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

entity-relationship-graph.name: Entity Relationship Graph
entity-relationship-graph.when: Rendering entity relationship graph: An interactive force-directed graph of typed nodes + relationship-labeled edges with drag / zoom / pan / hover / click and SVG/PNG export — for visualizing VectorDB entity relationships, agent-memory connections, embedding clusters, or useExtractEntities (NER) co-occurrences. The layout runs entirely client-side over local data via a lightweight in-component force simulation (no d3-force, no network). Exports layoutGraph().
entity-relationship-graph.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

entity-stats-bar.name: Entity Stats Bar
entity-stats-bar.when: Rendering entity stats bar: A horizontal stats bar showing the total detected-entity count plus per-type breakdown badges (PER / LOC / ORG / MISC — colored dot + count + label), computing counts internally from a DetectedEntity[] (or a pre-computed counts map) against a color/label registry. Pairs with useExtractEntities. Self-contained; exports countByType().
entity-stats-bar.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

error-alert.name: Error Alert
error-alert.when: Rendering error alert: A compact, dismissible error surface with an optional retry action - a role=alert region showing the message, a Retry button (only when onRetry is provided), and a dismiss control. Presentational: the consumer owns the operation state and decides what retry and dismiss do. The deduped shared alert for operation feedback near a result. Pairs with any hook that surfaces an error string.
error-alert.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

evaluation-metrics-dashboard.name: Evaluation Metrics Dashboard
evaluation-metrics-dashboard.when: Rendering evaluation metrics dashboard: A composite evaluation dashboard: a KPI/stat-tile row (value + delta), a grid of metric cards (accuracy / precision / recall / F1), a color-coded N×N confusion matrix (diagonal success-tinted, off-diagonal error-tinted, intensity scaled to max cell, with legend), a radar/spider sub-view, and a threshold-calibration panel. Driven by useEvaluateModel + useCalibrateThreshold. All charts are minimal in-component SVG — no external chart library. Each section is optional.
evaluation-metrics-dashboard.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

mode-error-boundary.name: Mode Error Boundary
mode-error-boundary.when: Rendering mode error boundary: A React error boundary that isolates a render failure in its subtree: it catches the error, renders a compact recoverable role=alert notice with the message and a Reset button that clears the error and re-renders the children, so one failing surface cannot blank the whole page. A structural copy-owned utility with local prop shapes.
mode-error-boundary.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

redacted-text-display.name: Redacted Text Display
redacted-text-display.when: Rendering redacted text display: An inline-annotated text renderer interleaving plain text with color-coded redaction tokens (e.g. [PER], [LOC]) styled per entity type with native tooltips, including a scanning loading skeleton and an empty placeholder. Takes source text + detected entity spans (start/end) from useExtractEntities; segments internally (overlaps resolved by earliest). Exports segmentText().
redacted-text-display.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

scored-result-bar-list.name: Scored Result Bar List
scored-result-bar-list.when: Rendering scored result bar list: A ranked vertical list of {label, score} pairs — each row shows the label, a confidence percentage (via ConfidenceScoreBadge), and an animated horizontal fill bar proportional to the 0–1 score, with the top row highlighted. Ships skeleton-loading and empty-state slots. One data contract serves useClassify / useClassifyZeroShot / useDetectObjects / useFillMask / useSemanticSearch.
scored-result-bar-list.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

threshold-calibration-panel.name: Threshold Calibration Panel
threshold-calibration-panel.when: Rendering threshold calibration panel: A presentational panel for similarity-threshold calibration results: the empirically calibrated threshold shown side-by-side with the model's preset default (or an explicit no-preset state), calibration metadata (percentile, sample size, model ID, distance function), the pairwise similarity-distribution statistics (mean / median / std-dev / min / max / pair count), and a reference list of known-good preset thresholds with the active model highlighted. Loading and empty states carry optional calibrate / cancel affordances. Designed from the ThresholdCalibration result shape; the full-fidelity standalone complement to evaluation-metrics-dashboard's embedded calibration sub-view. Driven by useCalibrateThreshold (pair presetThreshold with getDefaultThreshold and presets with MODEL_THRESHOLD_PRESETS). All in-component SVG-free token styling — no chart library.
threshold-calibration-panel.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

top-result-card.name: Top Result Card
top-result-card.when: Rendering top result card: A hero card highlighting the single winning classification result — large label, prominent radial confidence dial (via ConfidenceScoreBadge), and a tier-tinted gradient-border glow. Designed to pair above a ScoredResultBarList; serves any single-winner output (sentiment, intent, language detection, gesture, zero-shot). Pairs with useClassifyZeroShot (top result).
top-result-card.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

differential-privacy-controls.name: Differential Privacy Controls
differential-privacy-controls.when: Rendering differential privacy controls: A collapsible DP settings panel (enable toggle, epsilon slider with derived High/Balanced/Low label, privacy-budget bar that warns/errors as budget is consumed) plus a compact "DP Applied" provenance badge (epsilon used, embedding dimensionality). Driven by the app's dpEmbeddingMiddleware/dpClassificationMiddleware + DP-budget state; the component only renders. No turnkey hook.
differential-privacy-controls.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

lock-status-badge.name: Lock Status Badge
lock-status-badge.when: Rendering lock status badge: A compact session-lock indicator accepting a status of locked, unlocked, or no-vault, with distinct iconography per state and an accessible text label (never color alone). Purely presentational — holds no key material. Pairs with the status field of useEncryptedVault.
lock-status-badge.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

passphrase-gate.name: Passphrase Gate
passphrase-gate.when: Rendering passphrase gate: A controlled passphrase screen with create and unlock modes: create renders passphrase + confirmation with a minimum-length gate and composes the password-strength-bar from caller-computed strength props; unlock renders a single field with an error surface (e.g. wrong passphrase) and busy state. Submits the passphrase via onSubmit; performs no crypto and retains no passphrase. Pairs with useEncryptedVault.
passphrase-gate.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

password-strength-bar.name: Password Strength Bar
password-strength-bar.when: Rendering password strength bar: A presentational password/passphrase strength meter — a themed bar + label driven by a caller-computed 0–100 strength score. The app computes strength (pairs with @localmode/core deriveKey/crypto); the component only renders. No turnkey hook.
password-strength-bar.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.

vault-item-card.name: Vault Item Card
vault-item-card.when: Rendering vault item card: A lock-state-aware card for an encrypted note or text document: locked renders a masked body with disabled actions (no plaintext in the DOM); unlocked renders title/timestamp with reveal/hide toggling of caller-supplied decrypted content and a delete action, all via callbacks. Never receives ciphertext or key material. Pairs with useEncryptedVault.
vault-item-card.when_not: Non-React plain HTML pages or heavy monolithic cloud-only backends without browser AI awareness.
